fixes.name: axel
fixes.prompt: Edit target: supplied supplemental animation sheet. Preserve EXACT character design, clothing, face, weapon, colors, pose ORDER and all 12 poses. Change ONLY the sheet spacing and uniform figure scale. Re-layout as exactly FOUR columns by 3 rows on regular transparent cells, with wide empty gutters. Make EVERY figure uniformly smaller: upright body only 45 percent of cell height. ALL complete silhouettes, including guitars/hair/lying boots, must fit INSIDE the central 75 percent of each cell WIDTH and 75 percent HEIGHT. NO figure may cross into a neighboring cell, and no bounding rectangles may overlap. Keep same physical body proportions and identical scale between upright and lying poses. Soles at90% cell baseline. Real transparent background, no guides/text/shadows/effects. This is a technical spacing correction, not a redesign. Use larger canvas if needed to retain detail.
